name: value-utilities/gradients
description: Gradient family. `bg-gradient-to-{t,tr,r,br,b,bl,l,tl}` are statics that set `background-image: linear-gradient(<dir>, var(--tw-gradient-stops))`. `from-`, `via-`, `to-` value plugins fill the cascade vars. `from-<color>` writes `--tw-gradient-from`, `--tw-gradient-to` (transparent same-color via upstream's `transparentTo` / `withAlphaValue(value, 0, ...)`), and `--tw-gradient-stops`. `via-<color>` rewrites the stops chain to insert the via color in the middle. `to-<color>` just writes `--tw-gradient-to`. Each prefix shares with a position plugin (`from-50%`, `via-30%`, `to-95%`) that consults `theme.gradientColorStopPositions` (0%..100% step 5).
